name: Rosaria
quote: And as far as I'm concerned, the things I deal with are far simpler than living the life of a traditional sister.
description: A sister of the Church of Favonius who prefers action over prayer, Rosaria is a Cryo polearm fighter who often slips away from her clerical duties to handle tasks quietly in the shadows, having been given a second chance in Mondstadt by Grand Master Varka.
